title: Uniform reduction bounds on any flat-term K-flat quotient representative
statement: For a prime l, finite coefficient extension E, a scheme T with l invertible, an integral constructible derived object M [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], any flat-term K-flat complex P [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and isomorphism Q(P)≅M, there exist p≤r such that every actual quotient complex Res(P⊗A_(n+1)) [def-pur-integral-derived-operations] is cohomologically ≥p and ≤r. This is a bound on cohomology, with no bound on the terms of P or on Tor amplitude.

proof.text: Choose p≤r from the defining uniform-support clause of sfIntegralConstructible. It bounds all positive derived reductions of M, including n=0 corresponding to exponent one.

proof.text: Use unrestrictedTowerResolutionIso for the identity resolution of P, then compose with scalarReductionDerivedExtension.mapIso q.symm. This identifies the actual finite quotient of P with the derived reduction of M through the published localization counit.

proof.text: The homology factorization through Q transports the support vanishing to the finite quotient complex. Exact scalar restriction maps the resulting exact short complexes to exact short complexes over the completed ring. Mathlib isGE_iff and isLE_iff identify these exactness conditions with the asserted bounds.

theorem integralQuotientCohomologicalBounds (T : Scheme.{u}) [∀ x : T, Invertible (l : T.residueField x)]
    (M : DerivedCategory (integralTowerModules l E T))
    (hM : sfIntegralConstructible l E T M)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E T).FullSubcategory)
    (q : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj ≅ M) :
    ∃ p r : ℤ, p ≤ r ∧ ∀ n : ℕ,
      CochainComplex.IsGE ((unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E T n).obj P.obj) p ∧
        CochainComplex.IsLE ((unrestrictedIntegralComplexFunctor l E T n).obj P.obj) r
